title: Undead Slayer Crossbow
summary: A +2 heavy crossbow with an extra attack and damage bonus against Undead.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d10 + 2 Piercing plus Dexterity, +2 to attack rolls. Martial two-handed heavy crossbow, 60 ft.
fields.Revenant Scourge: Against Undead, this weapon adds 1d4 to attack and damage rolls. The similarly named Long Arm of the Gur lacks the hidden status enabling this passive.
fields.Piercing Shot: Action with proficiency once per Short Rest. Make a ranged weapon attack. Constitution save against weapon-action DC +2 prevents Gaping Wounds for 2 turns. Undead and Constructs are immune. In standard modes successful attacks deal 2 extra Piercing. In Honour, damage sources add 2 of their damage type. Healing ends the condition.
fields.Brace: Spend 20 ft movement with proficiency once per Short Rest. Roll ranged damage twice and use the higher roll until turn end. Breaks Hiding and Invisibility. Heavy crossbows have a separate cooldown from longbows.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
